question_en: I am a farmer from a Scheduled Caste household. Under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM), what financial assistance for purchase of agricultural machinery by individual farmers, as a share of cost am I entitled to?
rule_table:
Official rule: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) — financial assistance for purchase of agricultural machinery by individual farmers, as a share of cost (percent of cost).
| beneficiary category | value |
|---|---|
| scheduled caste | 50 |
| scheduled tribe | 50 |
| woman | 50 |
| small or marginal farmer | 50 |
| other farmer | 40 |
(source: Operational Guidelines, Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (scanned, 68 pp.))

question_en: I am a farmer growing kharif paddy. Under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), what maximum premium payable by the farmer, as a share of sum insured am I entitled to?
rule_table:
Official rule: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) — maximum premium payable by the farmer, as a share of sum insured (percent of sum insured).
| beneficiary category | value |
|---|---|
| kharif food and oilseed crops | 2.0 |
| rabi food and oilseed crops | 1.5 |
| annual commercial and horticultural crops | 5.0 |
(source: PMFBY Operational Guidelines)
